answer.text:
Done. `rm -rf build` removed the folder, and it's confirmed gone — `ls: build: No such file or directory`, and it no longer appears in the workspace listing.

One note: `build/bundle.js` was tracked in git, so git now shows ` D build/bundle.js` as a pending deletion (alongside your pre-existing change to `.vscode/settings.json`). I left it uncommitted since you didn't ask for a commit. If you need the file back, `git restore build/bundle.js` will bring it from the initial commit.
